NOTIFICATION 03/2026.

Dt: 16.07.2026 of the DME, TG, Hyderabad.
Guidelines for recruitment and instructions to candidates:

recruitment to the posts mentioned at Para-2, sanctioned vide G.O.Rt.No.1276 Fin (HRM VII)

Outsourcing Basis up to 31/03/2027 or till the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier, and
renewal will be as per the need, if any and also subject to satisfactory performance.

3.Age : As prescribed by government the minimum and maximum age is 18 years and
44 years in terms of G.O.Ms.No.86 Dated:18.05.2026 of GAD (Ser.A) Dept. Government of
Telangana. The minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01.07.2026 with the
following relaxations allowed for reckoning the maximum age limit as per rules in force.
Sl.No Category of applications Relaxation of age permissible
1 SC/ST/ BCs & EWS 5 Years
2 Ex-Servicemen 3 Years
3 Persons with Disabilities 10 Years
4. SELECTION WILL BE DONE BASED ON THE FOLLOWING CRITERIA:
a. Total marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the marks obtained in
qualifying examination and 10 marks will be awarded for the age. Weightage for age
will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate. 0.5 marks will be awarded for
one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks. The age will be reckoned as
on 01.07.2026.
Example1: If a candidate completes 20 years as on 01.07.2026, he will be awarded
1.0 marks
Example2: If a candidate completes 30 years as on 01.07.2026, he will be awarded
6.0 marks
Example3: If a candidate completed 38 years of age as on 01.07.2026, he will be
awarded 10 marks.
b. Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained with above criteria and
displayed on website for transparency and also for calling objections.
c. Selection list will be prepared from the finalized merit list duly following the rule of
reservation and Presidential Order 2018.
i) Rule of reservation in respect of community, disability and Ex-Service
Men/Women shall be strictly observed as per the AP State and Subordinate
Service Rules,1996, adopted by Telangana State, read with the relevant
specific rules applicable.
ii) 33 1/3% reservations for women will be applicable as per the orders issued by
Government in G.O.Ms. No.3 department for Women, Children, Disabled &
Sr.Citizens (Prog.I) dated 10.02.2024 and in G.O.Ms.No.35, General
Administration (Ser.D) Dept., dated 13.02.2024.
iii) The above posts notified were organized into District Cadre, Zonal and
Multizonal vide G.O.Ms.No.177, General Administration (SPF-I) Department
Dated:04.08.2021.Thus candidates belongs to local cadre are only eligible for
the post.
5. UNIT OF APPOINTMENT (AS PER THE PRESIDENTIAL ORDER 2018).
As per the Presidential orders issued vide G.O.Ms.No.124 GAD (SPF.MC) Dept.
Dated: 30-8-2018 and amended from time to time, for each unit of appointment the reserved
and unreserved ratio, for each category is 95% reserved for LOCAL candidates and 5% is
unreserved.

6. HOW TO APPLY:
a. Applications form along with the instructions can be downloaded from the College
website: https://gmcrajannasircilla.org/
b. Filled in applications form shall be submitted in person from:30-10-2026 to 05-11-2026
5:00 PM at O/o the Principal, GMC, Rajanna Sircilla
c. Self-attested copies of the following certificates should be enclosed with the Application
form.
1 SSC or Equivalent examination Marks memo
2 Intermediate or 10+2 examination marks memo
3 Qualifying Examination Pass certificate/Diploma/Degree/First Aid training certificate
4 Marks memos of all the years (Qualifying examination)
5 Registration certificates from Telangana Para Medical Board/Telangana Nursing
Council/Telangna Dental Council(wherever applicable)
6 Experience certificate

State, i.e. SC Group-1, SC Group-II, and SC Group-III .

Note:- The District Selection Committee, Rajanna Sircilla reserves the right to cancel
the recruitment process of above posts at any stage and also informed that,
the notified posts, may vary increase / decrease and it is completely at the
discretion of the Principal GMC Rajanna Sircilla.
Tentative Schedule For Filling Up Above Posts :
1. Date of Issue of Notification : 28-10-2026
